instruction: Find the most frequently occurring name in column B. Put that name in cell F2 and its occurrence count in cell G2.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully identified 6 unique names from column B (with 17 entries containing duplicates) and typed them into column D in first-occurrence order. Completed in 9 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can read spreadsheet data, identify duplicates, type values into cells in LibreOffice Calc, navigate between cells
metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the most frequent name in column B (Jeff Tunnels, 5 occurrences) and putting the name in F2 and count in G2. Getter reads both cells, metric gives 0.5 for correct name and 0.5 for correct count. [Fixed: replaced invalid 8-char MD5 suffix with correct 32-char MD5 hash]
metadata.task_rationale: Original task required extracting unique names; this variation tests frequency analysis, a complementary data analysis skill using the same dataset.

scoring_breakdown.name: 0.5 - Correct most frequent name in F2
